meta.description: Animated human characters made of glowing atoms, with expressive faces, nine animation states, and interactive particle effects.

hints.idle: Breathes, blinks, and follows you with its gaze.
hints.thinking: Tilts its head as thoughts become orbiting atoms.
hints.searching: Looks around as a wave of light scans its body.
hints.listening: Leans toward you as atom rings pulse rhythmically.
hints.speaking: Its atom lips move as light spreads across its face.
hints.working: Focuses as waves of energy rise through its body.
hints.happy: Smiles, jumps, and scatters golden atoms around it.
hints.error: Shakes its head as its atoms flicker red.
hints.sleeping: Closes its eyes as its atom light slowly breathes.

accessibility.character: Atom human, {{state}}. Click or press Enter or Space to react.

interactionHint: Follows your pointer · Click the character to react
